about_the_game:
Try the demo of Obliterator-X, a brutal roguelike tower defense game packed with mutant chaos and real-time drone strategy.

This demo lets you play through the tutorial to get familiar with the game’s mechanics, and then jump into one full round of the main game, where you’ll scavenge, build defenses, and fight off waves of enemies.

Expect a taste of the action, including:

  • Assignable combat drones

  • Turret and trap placement

  • Procedural enemy waves

  • Resource scavenging and base setup

In Obliterator-X, every run begins with a short scavenging phase before enemies arrive, letting you explore buildings for loot and choose how to prepare. You will place traps, set turrets, and assign drones to suit your strategy. If you die, you bring back materials, experience, and new upgrades that permanently improve your odds in future runs.

Your time before the wave begins is critical. Use it to loot abandoned rooms, uncover powerful new weapons, and find blueprints for advanced defenses. Drones can be assigned to help you explore or guard key areas, letting you adapt your plan on the fly based on what you find and what is coming.

After each run, return to your base of operations where you can spend collected scrap, electronics, and food to unlock and build new facilities. Each building adds new functionality to the game, such as unlocking a minimap, revealing enemy paths, or increasing the power of your tech. Every structure can also be upgraded, creating long-term progression and new layers of strategy.

Use the skill tree to unlock powerful passive bonuses across four categories: Combat, Defense, Science, and Resources. Improve your stun effects, increase your resource yields, unlock smarter drone behaviors, and more. Every decision you make helps define your playstyle and build toward a stronger survivor.

Each successful run brings you closer to uncovering new parts of the world map. Explore distinct biomes, each with their own enemy types, environmental hazards, and loot opportunities. Whether it's a scorched outback, frozen wasteland, or twisted city ruin, every zone offers new challenges and strategic choices. As you unlock new regions, you will also encounter tougher enemy waves and better gear, encouraging long-term progression and replayability.

▐░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░▌

WHAT MAKES OBLITERATOR-X UNIQUE?

Obliterator-X goes beyond the basics of tower defense by combining fast-paced action, meaningful roguelike progression, and deep strategic flexibility. Whether you are scavenging for blueprints or micro-managing your drones mid-wave, every run feels fresh and full of decision-making.

  • 🧠 A flexible skill tree across four distinct branches: Combat, Defense, Science, and Resources

  • 🛠️ Unlockable and upgradeable HQ buildings that permanently expand your options and gameplay layers

  • 🤖 Assignable drone units that respond to real-time commands and adapt to your strategy

  • 🔄 A run-based structure where every failure makes your next attempt stronger

  • 🔫 A huge arsenal of traps, turrets, and weapons to discover and experiment with

  • 📦 A scavenging system that makes every map feel like a risk-reward puzzle

  • 💀 Bloody, chaotic enemy waves mixed with goofy charm and dark humor

short_description: Mutant hordes have taken over Earth. Play as the clone of a deranged scientist and test your survival skills in this roguelike tower defense demo. Learn the ropes in the tutorial, then dive into one round of explosive chaos in the Australian Outback.
